name: Two-network voltage measurement selector
aliases: Two-network voltage measurement selector IEC reference
summary: This representation distinguishes voltage selection between two three-phase networks.
description: This representation distinguishes voltage selection between two three-phase networks. The measurement is selected from more than one network or bus system. Both source identities must remain visible so that a reading is not attributed to the wrong supply.
Tag the two measurement sources and provide a position table with each voltage pair. This selector does not create a load-supply transfer arrangement between the networks.
readingNotes: Identify both sources and each selectable measurement connection.
Measurement selection between networks is not an automatic source-transfer power switch.
